state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> [TICKETME] -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(device-claims-match-shims) -> PROVED
intent: Settle what makes a thing a device in Cairn — the shim FITTED to it and the protocols it answers, not a class it inherits — and derive the base device from the librarian, which Akien names as its template.
why: Akien, 2026-08-11: 'a shim fits TO the device; you + your shim = your device.' Calibre was a UU device with no device code at all — just its shim — because Calibre itself managed the books. Device-ness therefore cannot be inheritance, and no class read can ever see an external device. Today BaseDevice IS the physics (Law 4) and it enforces the axis we no longer hold, which is why writing the rule down again is not the fix: with the rule stated plainly in conversation, CC still measured device-ness by reading BaseDevice inheritance twice in the same session. A rule that loses to a habit inside one session is not a rule yet.
traces_to: Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy; BaseDevice is the physics enforcing the wrong axis. Law 3 — 'is it a device?' is a behavioral question and a class read is a proxy for it; Akien's 2026-08-11 health-query ruling ('every device has a presence on the bus and can respond to a health query... as to census, what census?') already named asking the running thing as the real measurement.
falsifier: DONE when 'is X a device?' is answered by ASKING X — a health query over the bus — and a Calibre-shaped member passes: external, shim only, no Python device object, inheriting nothing. HORIZON: the predicate must be RUN against the live roster at least once; a written-but-unrun predicate is exactly the prose this ticket exists to replace. WRONG INTENT if the librarian does not generalize — the tell is that extracting the base leaves the librarian unchanged and the base carrying only fields no second device wants.
children: the-shim-declares-its-device-contract (claimed from ticket every-device-has-a-presence rather than duplicated)

measured_at_cast.instrument: import_sieve importers_of, run at the design step — not read
measured_at_cast.divergence: The two axes disagree about SIX components: six things inherit device-hood and have no fitted shim. cairn/trouble/trouble.py is one of them — which answers the sibling alarms node's central question ('should trouble be a device') by measurement before that node got to ask it.

open_at_cast: Does the librarian generalize? It is ONE instance and the most elaborated one, so the template may encode its specifics — graph trees, tenure loop — as though they were universal. The check: extract, then ask what a SECOND device wants from it. Carried openly rather than resolved, because extraction is the only way to test it.
Does BaseShim invert to become the load-bearing class and BaseDevice the optional one? Reasoned to, NOT checked against the spine. Carried as an open question, not a settled claim.
charter_deltas_owed: cairn/base/intention+why.json — record the collision at BOTH ends. Base's charter asserts 'a value carried by a class you cannot subclass without is physics (Law 4)'; that claim to define device-ness ends here. Its real why — the UNIFORM INTROSPECTION SURFACE, 'the tester probes one protocol, the web UI renders one protocol' — survives intact and is the same axis Akien named. Inheritance was the delivery mechanism, not the value. The edit is part of this ticket's deliverable, not a follow-up someone remembers: a collision recorded only on the newcomer leaves the older artifact still asserting what we stopped believing (Law 5).

watchme.trigger: each poke of cairn/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh — an event that already fires on every charter write and every /intent model consult. No clock, no new firing path.
watchme.enough: symmetric difference zero across three consecutive pokes AND every component carrying the device role exercised by the predicate at least once. Zero-on-an-unexercised-set is the vacuous green this field refuses.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: both sets named per component and their symmetric difference. Starts at 6.
watchme.nexus: the device roster tree — the same tree roster() reads.
watchme.consumer: Akien at his gate for the first three pokes; a divergence persisting past 'enough' raises to the trouble lane.
